finance.title: Global Tech Outage Highlights Risks of Relying on Small Tech Provider Groups
finance.summary: 微軟針對長達近24小時的全球大當機深表歉意。專家指出，這次事件再次提醒人們，全球社會過度依賴少數大型科技提供商所帶來的潛在風險。
english: Microsoft issued an apology and said it was deeply sorry after a major global outage caused disruption for almost 24 hours. The widespread system failure created significant challenges for various organizations, highlighting how modern business operations can be disrupted when essential digital services fail unexpectedly.

Experts commented on the severe event, stating that it serves as a stark reminder of the risks involved when critical infrastructure depends heavily on a small group of big tech providers. They noted that an outage of this scale demonstrates how vulnerable international systems are when relying on a limited number of service vendors.

Following the resolution of the disruption, industry analysts urged firms to review their technical contingency plans and assess their exposure to major suppliers. Companies are now evaluating how to strengthen their operational resilience to prevent future financial and administrative difficulties if similar technical outages occur again.
translation: 在一次長達近24小時並造成混亂的全球重大當機事件後，微軟表達了歉意並表示深感抱歉。這次廣泛的系統故障對各大機構造成了重大挑戰，凸顯出當關鍵數位服務意外失效時，現代商業運作可能會受到嚴重干擾。
專家對此嚴重事件發表看法，指出這是一個殘酷的提醒，警示人們當關鍵基礎設施高度依賴少數大型科技提供商時所涉及的風險。他們提到，這種規模的當機顯示出國際系統在依賴有限數量的服務供應商時是多麼脆弱。
在混亂情況解決之後，業界分析師呼籲企業檢視其技術應變計劃，並評估對主要供應商的依賴程度。各大公司目前正在評估如何強化其營運韌性，以防止未來再次發生類似技術當機時產生財務和行政困境。

part5.prompt: The IT management team decided to review their digital architecture _______ the major network disruption was successfully resolved.
part5.locator: Subordinate conjunction introducing a time clause following a completed event
part5.explanation: 句意為「在重大網路中斷成功解決之後，資訊管理團隊決定檢視他們的數位架構。」此處需要一個時間連接詞來引導附屬子句，後接已完成的事件，故選表示「在……之後」的 (A) after。(B) despite 為介系詞；(C) during 為介系詞；(D) whereas 為對比連接詞，皆不符合文法與句意。

part5.prompt: Recent technical failures show that corporations must not depend _______ on a single technology provider for all their critical services.
part5.explanation: 句意為「近期的技術故障顯示，企業絕不能過度依賴單一科技提供商來獲得所有關鍵服務。」此處需要副詞來修飾動詞 depend，故選副詞 (B) excessively（過度地）。(A) 為形容詞；(C) 為名詞；(D) 為動詞過去式，均不符合文法修飾需求。

part5.prompt: Financial analysts suggest _______ contingency reserves to cushion the firm against unexpected technological failures.
part5.locator: Verb pattern requiring a gerund after 'suggest'
part5.explanation: 句意為「財務分析師建議維持應變準備金，以緩衝公司面臨意外技術故障時的衝擊。」動詞 suggest 後面若接動詞作為受詞，需使用動名詞形式（V-ing），故正確答案為 (B) maintaining。

part6.title: Internal Announcement: IT Infrastructure Review
part6.passage:
To All Department Heads,

Following the recent system disturbance, our company is conducting a thorough evaluation of our operational dependence on third-party service providers. The executive board wants to ensure that our critical data remains secure and accessible. 【1】.

We request that all department managers submit a detailed report listing every external software tool currently used by their teams. It is essential to identify any potential vulnerability in our current workflows 【2】 financial or administrative operations are further interrupted. Please make sure to include backup protocols in your report.

Our goal is to increase overall resilience 【3】 diversifying our technology vendors and refining our response procedures. Additional training sessions regarding emergency technical measures will be scheduled next month. 【4】 for your prompt cooperation in this important initiative.

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank 【1】.
options: Our primary cloud service experienced an unexpected system failure yesterday.
We have decided to cancel all upcoming internal training seminars.
Marketing budgets will be increased significantly next quarter.
The company recently celebrated its twentieth anniversary with a banquet.
questions.locator: 第 1 段 "Following the recent system disturbance, our company is conducting a thorough evaluation of our operational dependence on third-party service providers."
questions.explanation: 第一段前文提到「在近期發生系統干擾之後，我們公司正對第三方服務提供商的營運依賴進行徹底評估」，選項 (A)「我們的核心雲端服務昨天經歷了意外的系統故障」最契合前文關於系統干擾的背景說明。

questions.prompt: Choose the best option to fill in blank 【2】.
questions.locator: 第 2 段 "It is essential to identify any potential vulnerability in our current workflows 【2】 financial or administrative operations are further interrupted."
questions.explanation: 此處需填入連詞以連結「找出工作流程中的潛在漏洞」與「財務或行政運作遭到進一步干擾」。選 (A) before（在……之前）最符合邏輯，表示「在財務或行政運作進一步中斷之前，找出潛在漏洞至關重要」。

questions.prompt: Choose the best option to fill in blank 【3】.
questions.locator: 第 3 段 "Our goal is to increase overall resilience 【3】 diversifying our technology vendors and refining our response procedures."
questions.explanation: 空格後面跟著動名詞短語 "diversifying... and refining..."，表達「透過」這些手段來達到提升整體韌性的目標。介系詞 by + V-ing 表示方法或手段，故選 (A) by。

questions.prompt: Choose the best option to fill in blank 【4】.
questions.locator: 第 3 段 "【4】 for your prompt cooperation in this important initiative."
questions.explanation: 公告結尾通常會對員工的配合表達感謝。"Thank you for..." 為標準的商業公文用語，故選 (A) Thank you。

politics.title: Labour Reviews Election Defeat in Wales
politics.summary: 英國工黨將於週六公佈今年五月威爾斯議會歷史性敗選的檢討報告，威爾斯領袖指出工黨與選民失去了聯繫。
english: On Saturday, the Labour Party will officially release a comprehensive review examining its historic defeat during the Senedd elections held in May. This evaluation aims to understand the root causes behind the disappointing electoral outcome.

According to the regional leader, the party unfortunately lost its vital connection with local voters over time. This growing detachment ultimately created a significant barrier between the political leadership and the everyday public.

Party officials hope that publishing this honest assessment will help them regain public trust. The upcoming review serves as a crucial first step toward rebuilding their political foundation ahead of future campaigns.
translation: 週六，工黨將正式發布一份全面的檢討報告，審視其在五月舉行的威爾斯議會選舉中所遭受的歷史性敗選。這項評估旨在了解令人失望的選舉結果背后的根本原因。
據該地區領袖表示，該黨不幸地隨著時間推移失去了與當地選民的至關重要的聯繫。這種日益增長的疏離感最終在政治領導層與普通公眾之間造成了巨大的障礙。
黨內官員希望發表這項誠實的評估能有助於他們重新獲得公眾信任。即將到來的檢討報告是邁向在未來競選之前重建其政治基礎的關鍵第一步。

part5.explanation: 空格後面接名詞「vital connection」，需要一個所有格形容詞來修飾。選項「its」是所有格，用來修飾「the party」的連接。「it」為主格或受格，「itself」為反身代名詞，「it's」為「it is」或「it has」的縮寫。

techLife.title: Illicit Trade Allegations Challenge Singapore's Semiconductor Reputation
techLife.summary: 報導指出黃仁勳相關爭議引發關注，使新加坡在展現晶片產業成功之餘，也面臨涉嫌非法貿易活動帶來的管治挑戰與商譽壓力。
english: A recent scandal involving Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has raised serious concerns for business-friendly Singapore. The situation has highlighted the nation's growing prominence as a major global chip hub, demonstrating its ability to attract high-tech enterprise investment. However, it has simultaneously exposed operational vulnerabilities regarding commercial oversight within the technology sector.

The controversy has cast a strong spotlight on alleged illicit trade activities operating through local channels. Singapore has long cultivated an environment designed to streamline corporate expansion and foster international investment. As a result, news of unauthorized transactions has created a significant administrative headache for government officials attempting to maintain economic openness alongside strict regulatory compliance.

Moving forward, industry experts suggest that regulatory authorities may increase monitoring to prevent illegal commercial practices. Maintaining Singapore's reputation as a secure and reliable trade center remains vital for its ongoing success in the global semiconductor market. Consequently, policymakers face the delicate task of addressing compliance risks without undermining the hub's competitive business ecosystem.
translation: 近期涉及輝達執行長黃仁勳的爭議引發了親商的新加坡高度關注。此情況凸顯了該國作為全球主要晶片樞紐日益重要的地位，展現出其吸引高科技企業投資的能力。然而，這同時也暴露了科技領域在商業監管方面的營運漏洞。
這場爭議使透過在地管道進行的涉嫌非法貿易活動成為各界焦點。新加坡長期以來打造致力於簡化企業擴展並促進國際投資的環境。因此，未經授權交易的消息為試圖在維持經濟開放與嚴格法規遵循之間取得平衡的政府官員帶來了嚴重的行政難題。
展望未來，產業專家建議主管機關可能會加強監測，以防止非法商業行為。維護新加坡作為安全可靠貿易中心的聲譽，對於其在全球半導體市場的持續成功至關重要。因此，政策制定者面臨著在不破壞該樞紐具競爭力商業生態系統的前提下，處理合規風險的微妙任務。

part6.title: Corporate Compliance Advisory
part6.passage:
To All Semiconductor Trade Partners,

In light of recent developments regarding international supply chain integrity, our trade monitoring division is introducing revised compliance procedures. Recent industry events have drawn global attention to potential risks in electronics distribution. 【1】

Starting next month, all registered export firms must submit additional verification documents prior to completing overseas transactions. The goal is to strengthen commercial oversight and ensure that local channels remain completely free of 【2】 activities. While we recognize that these added requirements may present a temporary administrative 【3】, they are essential to protecting our trading ecosystem.

【4】 We appreciate your prompt cooperation in maintaining our position as a trusted global business center.

Sincerely,
Global Compliance Directorate

finance.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal
finance.summary: 晶片製造巨頭輝達的執行長黃仁勳在醜聞爆發後辭職，使該公司陷入混亂，美國國會議員並要求就其是否涉及中國間諜進行質問。
english: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has decided to quit his position, plunging the major AI chipmaking giant into sudden turmoil. The shocking departure of the top executive creates significant uncertainty for the future of the technology corporation. Market observers note that this unexpected development severely impacts investor confidence across the global semiconductor industry.

Following this dramatic announcement, US lawmakers have expressed intense concern regarding the leadership crisis. Reports indicate that these government officials now want to question the former chief executive directly. Lawmakers specifically intend to investigate whether one of his alleged relationships involved a Chinese spy.

The unfolding situation leaves the prominent artificial intelligence enterprise facing severe regulatory scrutiny and public attention. Corporate governance experts emphasize that resolving these leadership and security questions quickly is vital for restoring stability. Meanwhile, stakeholders wait anxiously for further official statements from the board of directors regarding the ongoing investigation.
translation: 陷入醜聞的輝達執行長黃仁勳已決定辭職，使這家大型人工智慧晶片製造巨頭陷入突然的混亂。這位高階主管的震驚離職，為這家科技公司的未來創造了巨大的不確定性。市場觀察家指出，這項未預期的發展嚴重影響了全球半導體產業的投資人信心。
在此戲劇性宣布之後，美國國會議員對領導危機表達了強烈的關注。報導指出，這些政府官員現在希望直接質問這位前執行長。國會議員特別打算調查他其中一段據稱的關係是否涉及中國間諜。
局勢的發展使這家知名的人工智慧企業面臨嚴格的監管審查與大眾關注。企業治理專家強調，迅速解決這些領導與安全問題對於恢復穩定至關重要。同時，利害關係人焦慮地等待董事會就正在進行的調查發表進一步的官方聲明。

politics.summary: 內政部關於在比切斯特附近基地收容多達1256名男子的申請已獲得快速審批通過。
english: The Home Office recently submitted an application to house asylum seekers at a military base near Bicester. This project aims to provide shelter for up to 1256 men on the site.
Local authorities and officials reviewed the proposal carefully. Due to the nature of the request, the administrative process for the site was fast-tracked by the government.
Following the review period, the official planning approval was granted. The decision allows the department to move forward with utilizing the location for housing purposes.

經過審查期後，官方的規劃批准獲得了授權。該決定允許該部門推進利用該地點進行住宅用途的工作。

finance.title: Nvidia CEO Faces Increased Scrutiny Amid Leadership Reports
finance.summary: 知名科技企業輝達執行長黃仁勳在媒體報導第二起婚外情後，正面臨升級的輿論壓力，其個人領導地位與未來動向引發市場高度關注。
english: Mounting public and investor pressure is currently building on Jensen Huang, the billionaire chief executive officer of the technology giant Nvidia. Recent news reports indicate that the executive is involved in a second extramarital affair. This development has raised major concerns among market analysts about corporate governance and leadership stability at the firm.

The emerging reports have placed the future of the high-profile tech leader in question as stakeholder scrutiny intensifies. Investors are closely observing how the board of directors will address these allegations. Concerns are growing regarding whether the ongoing controversy could potentially distract management or impact the corporate reputation of the company.

As uncertainty surrounds the executive suite, market participants are carefully evaluating potential operational risks. Analysts note that executive reputation plays a vital role in maintaining investor confidence, particularly in the rapidly competitive technology sector. Further official statements from the firm are expected as stakeholders monitor the situation.
translation: 科技巨頭輝達的億萬富豪執行長黃仁勳，目前正面臨日益增加的公眾與投資者壓力。最新的新聞報導指出，該名高階主管捲入了第二起婚外情。這項發展引發了市場分析師對該公司企業治理與領導層穩定性的重大疑慮。
隨著利害關係人的審視力道加強，這些新出現的報導使這位高調的科技領袖的未來陷入不確定狀態。投資人正在密切觀察董事會將如何處理這些指控。人們對於持續發酵的爭議是否可能分散管理層注意力或影響公司聲譽的擔憂日益增加。
由於高階管理層籠罩著不確定性，市場參與者正在仔細評估潛在的營運風險。分析師指出，高階主管的聲譽在維持投資人信心方面扮演著至關重要的角色，特別是在競爭激烈的科技領域。隨著利害關係人持續關注局勢發展，預計該公司將做出進一步的官方說明。

politics.title: Proposed Welfare Overhaul Targets Benefits for Young People
politics.summary: 米爾本（Milburn）的審查報告建議對福利制度進行大幅改革，提議將 25 歲以下的年輕人移出主要疾病津貼之列。
english: A major review led by Milburn recommends a radical overhaul of the welfare system. The proposal suggests moving individuals under twenty-five off main sickness benefits. Policymakers aim to restructure support to encourage younger citizens toward work or training instead of long-term reliance on financial aid.

The upcoming report highlights concerns over the growing number of young adults claiming health-related assistance. Under the proposed changes, young claimants would be redirected to alternative support programs designed to foster employment skills. Supporters argue that early intervention will help prevent long-term dependency on government funds.

Opponents, however, express caution regarding the potential impact on vulnerable youth who face genuine health challenges. As government officials review the recommendations, debates continue over how to balance fiscal responsibility with social protection. Further details regarding the official implementation timeline are expected to be announced soon.
translation: 一項由米爾本（Milburn）主導的重大審查報告建議對福利制度進行大幅度的改革。該提議建議將 25 歲以下的個人移出主要的疾病津貼名單。政策制定者的目標是重組支援機制，以鼓勵年輕國民走向工作或培訓，而非長期依賴經濟援助。
即將公布的報告強調了人們對申請健康相關補助的年輕成年人數量增加的關注。在擬議的變更下，年輕申請者將被轉向旨在培養就業技能的替代支援計畫。支持者認為，早期干預將有助於防止對政府資金的長期依賴。
然而，反對者對這項政策可能對面臨真實健康挑戰的弱勢青年造成的影響表示審慎擔憂。隨著政府官員審查這些建議，關於如何在財政責任與社會保障之間取得平衡的辯論仍將持續。預計不久後將公布有關官方實施時程表的更多細節。

part5.locator: 不定詞片語「to + 原形動詞」結構
part5.explanation: 動詞「is reviewing」後面的介系詞/動名詞片語中包含「to + 動詞原形」的不定詞結構，用來表示目的。因此空缺處應填入原形動詞「restructure」。

part5.prompt: Government policy analysts have stressed the importance of early ______ to reduce financial dependency.
part5.locator: 形容詞修飾名詞（early + Noun）結構
part5.explanation: 形容詞「early」後面需要修飾一個名詞。選項 (C)「intervention」（干預）為名詞，符合「early intervention」（早期干預）的語意與語法。

part5.prompt: Details concerning the project's execution ______ to be released to the public by next Friday.
part5.locator: 主動詞一致性與被動語態（Plural Subject + are expected）
part5.explanation: 句子的主詞是複數名詞「Details」（細節），因此需要搭配複數動詞；且細節是被期待公布，應使用被動語態「are expected」。

part6.title: Policy Briefing Announcement
part6.passage:
MEMORANDUM
To: All Department Heads
From: Policy Research Unit
Subject: Upcoming Briefing on Public Welfare Reforms

Next week, our committee will host a seminar to analyze proposed changes to public welfare policy. A recent review recommends a comprehensive 【1】 of the existing support frameworks for young citizens. The objective of this briefing is to evaluate how these changes might influence national labor participation rates.

During the session, specialists will present data regarding young claimants and discuss alternative strategy models. Attendees will 【2】 to review policy documents prior to the meeting. 【3】.

We encourage all managerial staff to participate. Please confirm your attendance with the administrative assistant by Thursday afternoon. Timely preparation will ensure a 【4】 discussion during the event.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word to fill in blank 【1】.
questions.locator: 第 1 段 "a comprehensive 【1】 of the existing support frameworks"
questions.explanation: 不定冠詞「a」與形容詞「comprehensive」之後需要填入單數可數名詞「overhaul」（大修/全面改革）。

questions.prompt: Choose the best verb form to fill in blank 【2】.
questions.locator: 第 2 段 "Attendees will 【2】 to review policy documents"
questions.explanation: 助動詞「will」之後接原形動詞，且與主詞「Attendees」（與會者）搭配時需使用被動語態「be required」（被要求）。

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank 【3】.
options: The venue has not been decided yet.
This information will help us assess potential economic impacts.
All funding for the project has been cancelled.
Our team recently hired ten new junior researchers.
questions.locator: 第 2 段 "Attendees will be required to review policy documents prior to the meeting. 【3】."
questions.explanation: 前句提及與會者需要預先審閱政策文件，選項 (B)「這項資訊將有助於我們評估潛在的經濟影響」最符合上下文邏輯連貫性。

questions.prompt: Choose the best word to fill in blank 【4】.
questions.locator: 第 3 段 "will ensure a 【4】 discussion during the event."
questions.explanation: 冠詞「a」與名詞「discussion」之間需要填入形容詞「productive」（富有成效的）來修飾名詞。

techLife.title: New Indian Mega Library Faces Audit Over AI Book Controversy
techLife.summary: 泰晤士報或相關報導指出，印度坦米爾納德邦政府已下令對全邦的圖書館館藏進行內部稽查，起因是一座大型圖書館因涉嫌收藏人工智慧生成的書籍而引發爭議。
english: A newly established mega library in India has recently encountered a major scandal regarding books created by artificial intelligence. This unexpected controversy has prompted immediate administrative action across the region.

In response to the growing concerns about these machine-made publications, the government of Tamil Nadu has formally ordered an internal audit. Officials will now carefully review library collections throughout the entire state.

The ongoing investigation aims to ensure the quality and authenticity of all materials available to the public. Authorities intend to clarify how such titles entered the official catalog during this administrative review.
translation: 印度一座新建立的大型圖書館最近遭遇了一起關於人工智慧創作書籍的重大醜聞。這起意料之外的爭議促使該地區採取了立即的行政行動。
針對對這些機器製造出版品日益增長的擔憂，坦米爾納德邦政府已正式下令進行內部稽查。官員們現在將仔細審查全邦各地的圖書館館藏。
正在進行的調查旨在確保公眾可獲得的所有資料之品質與真實性。當局打算在此次行政審查期間釐清此類書名是如何進入官方目錄的。

part5.prompt: The Tamil Nadu government has formally ordered an internal audit to ensure that all library collections ________ high standards.
part5.locator: Infinitive and verb agreement after auxiliary verbs or modal structures
part5.explanation: 句中主詞為所有格與複數名詞「all library collections」，為複數概念，且「to ensure that...」子句中需要原形動詞來配合句型，因此選擇原形動詞「meet」作為正確答案。

part5.prompt: Officials will carefully review library books throughout the state ________ evaluate their authenticity and overall quality.
part5.locator: Purpose clause using 'in order to + verb'
part5.explanation: 空格後接原形動詞「evaluate」，表示目的（為了評估其真實性與整體品質），選項中只有「in order to」可接原形動詞並表達目的。

part5.prompt: The newly established mega library ________ a major scandal regarding artificial intelligence publications last week.
part5.explanation: 句尾明確的時間副詞「last week」（上週）指出此動作發生在過去，因此必須使用過去式動詞「encountered」。

part6.title: Internal Memo on Library Collection Review
part6.passage:
To all staff members, 

Following recent news reports regarding book controversies, our department has decided to implement new screening policies. All employees must review incoming materials 【1】 carefully. 

Furthermore, any titles produced by artificial intelligence should be reported to management immediately. This step is necessary 【2】 maintain public trust. 

Please ensure that your department follows these guidelines starting tomorrow. We appreciate your cooperation in this 【3】 matter. 

Sincerely, 
Library Administration 【4】.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word for blank 【1】.
questions.locator: 第 1 段 "All employees must review incoming materials 【1】 carefully."
questions.explanation: 句意表示員工必須「更加」仔細地審查進來的資料，這裡需要副詞比較級「more」來修飾副詞「carefully」。

questions.prompt: Choose the best word for blank 【2】.
questions.locator: 第 1 段 "This step is necessary 【2】 maintain public trust."
questions.explanation: 片語「necessary to + 原形動詞」用來表達「對於做某事是必要的」，因此介詞或不定詞粒子應選「to」。

questions.prompt: Choose the best word for blank 【3】.
questions.locator: 第 2 段 "We appreciate your cooperation in this 【3】 matter."
questions.explanation: 空格處需要形容詞來修飾名詞「matter」，選項中「important」為形容詞，意為「重要的事項」。

questions.prompt: Choose the best word for blank 【4】.
questions.locator: 第 2 段 "Sincerely, Library Administration 【4】."
questions.explanation: 信件結尾署名處常搭配「Library Administration Office」（圖書館行政辦公室），故「Office」為最合適的單字。
